verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no event-triggered automation rules, such as "when event X happens, do action Y". GrowthBook's "rules" are targeting and rollout rules that decide which flag value a user sees. Ramp schedules and release plans are time-based, not event-triggered. The toggle endpoint called from a deploy script is a user-side workaround. The significance email alerts mentioned by a community user are notifications, not user-defined trigger-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
